payload.raw: {"action":"ask","domain":"risk","request_type":"explain","question":"How does Risk Analytics define an active loan (which status codes or conditions)?"}

payload.question: How does Risk Analytics define an active loan (which status codes or conditions)?

payload.raw: {"answer": "In Risk Analytics, an active account is one that is on the books (on_book = 1), not in forbearance (forbearance_flag = 0), and less than 30 days past due (days_past_due < 30). This is narrower than the Servicing definition of active. It is based on these conditions rather than a single status code. Segment codes (L1/L2 = low, M1 = medium, H1/H2 = high risk) are risk tiers and are not part of the active definition."}
